target.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure
target.body:
## Summary
- split requester wake success from visible message-tool delivery status for subagent completions
- preserve requester/parent wake when required group/channel visible delivery fails to produce message-tool evidence
- persist visible delivery failure details and mark linked detached task delivery as failed instead of delivered

## Why
For group/channel subagent completions, visible replies must still go through the message tool. When that visible delivery fails, the requester/parent wake should remain visible to orchestration instead of becoming a passive `pendingFinalDelivery` dead letter. The visible failure also must not be reported as successful task delivery.

This keeps the safety policy intact while preserving parent continuation and making task delivery accounting honest.

## Real behavior proof
**Behavior addressed:** subagent completion delivery where requester/parent handoff runs but the required group/channel visible reply does not produce message-tool evidence.

**Current PR head tested:** `09098d4ff67559d5ce492dd8c7e27d34b7dfceca`

**Real environment tested:** local OpenClaw source checkout on this PR branch, using the patched subagent registry lifecycle and SQLite registry store with a redacted current-head proof harness. The harness used an active requester session shape, a group/channel route represented as `message_tool_only`, and injected the required-message-tool no-evidence delivery result at the lifecycle boundary so the patched persistence/task-delivery behavior could be observed without posting to a real workspace.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch:**

```bash
node --import tsx '<redacted-temp-proof-script>'
```

**Evidence after fix:** terminal output from the current-head local OpenClaw lifecycle + SQLite restore proof harness:

```json
{
  "head": "09098d4ff67559d5ce492dd8c7e27d34b7dfceca",
  "scenario": {
    "requester": "active parent session",
    "visibleRoute": "group/channel completion configured as message_tool_only",
    "inducedVisibleFailure": "announce agent returned no message-tool delivery evidence",
    "expectedOutcome": "requester wake is credited as delivered while visible delivery failure metadata and linked task delivery failure are recorded and survive SQLite restore"
  },
  "deliveryResults": [
    {
      "delivered": true,
      "path": "direct",
      "requesterWakeStatus": "delivered",
      "visibleDeliveryRequired": true,
      "visibleDeliveryStatus": "failed",
      "visibleDeliveryError": "completion agent did not deliver through the message tool",
      "error": "completion agent did not deliver through the message tool"
    }
  ],
  "finalRunRecordDelivery": {
    "status": "failed",
    "requesterWakeDeliveredAt": 1780648012339,
    "visibleRequired": true,
    "visibleStatus": "failed",
    "visibleError": "completion agent did not deliver through the message tool",
    "deliveredAt": 1780648012339,
    "lastError": "completion agent did not deliver through the message tool",
    "announcedAt": 1780648012339
  },
  "sqliteRestoredDelivery": {
    "status": "failed",
    "deliveredAt": 1780648012339,
    "lastError": "completion agent did not deliver through the message tool",
    "requesterWakeDeliveredAt": 1780648012339,
    "visibleRequired": true,
    "visibleStatus": "failed",
    "visibleError": "completion agent did not deliver through the message tool",
    "announcedAt": 1780648012339
  },
  "detachedTaskDeliveryStatusUpdates": [
    {
      "runId": "pr-85308-proof-run",
      "runtime": "subagent",
      "sessionKey": "agent:worker:subagent:pr-85308-proof-child",
      "deliveryStatus": "failed",
      "error": "completion agent did not deliver through the message tool"
    }
  ],
  "keyAssertions": {
    "requesterWakeDeliveredAt": true,
    "deliveryStatusFailed": true,
    "visibleCompletionDeliveryRequired": true,
    "visibleCompletionDeliveryStatus": "failed",
    "completionAnnouncedAt": true,
    "completionDeliveredAt": true,
    "pendingFinalDeliveryCleared": true,
    "cleanupCompleted": true,
    "sqliteRestoreStatusFailed": true,
    "sqliteRestoreAnnouncedAtPreserved": true,
    "sqliteRestoreRequesterWakePreserved": true,
    "linkedTaskDeliveryStatusFailed": true,
    "noUnexpectedResume": true,
    "noFallbackSendMessage": true
  }
}
```

**Observed result after fix:** requester wake was recorded as delivered; `entry.delivery.status` became `failed`; visible delivery was marked required and failed; the pending delivery payload was cleared; cleanup completed; no fallback `sendMessage` path ran; the linked detached task delivery status was set to `failed` with the visible-delivery error; and SQLite restore preserved `delivery.status: "failed"` plus `announcedAt` / requester-wake timestamps instead of hydrating the run as delivered.

**What was not tested:** this proof did not send a live Slack/Discord message to an external channel. It intentionally exercises the required-message-tool no-evidence failure path in a redacted local current-head harness so the PR can show requester wake, persisted visible failure metadata, SQLite restore, and failed linked task-delivery status without posting to a real workspace.

## Tests
- `node --import tsx '<redacted-temp-proof-script>'` — current-head lifecycle + SQLite restore proof passed
- `corepack pnpm vitest run src/agents/subagent-registry.store.sqlite.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry-lifecycle.test.ts` — 4 files / 74 tests passed
- `corepack pnpm vitest run src/agents/subagent-registry.store.sqlite.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry-lifecycle.test.ts src/agents/subagent-announce-delivery.test.ts` — 6 files / 268 tests passed
- `corepack pnpm tsgo:core` — passed
- `corepack pnpm tsgo:core:test` — passed
- `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/subagent-registry.store.sqlite.ts src/agents/subagent-registry.store.sqlite.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry-lifecycle.ts src/agents/subagent-registry-lifecycle.test.ts` — passed
- `git diff --check` — passed

## Notes
- This PR intentionally treats requester wake success as terminal for this failure mode while reporting required visible delivery as failed.
- If maintainers want required visible output to keep retrying until message-tool evidence exists or retry limits expire, this should shift to a retry-preserving design instead.
